cause: The R59 towers stood to Z 16.5, 1.2 mm under the paddle plate. A full stroke takes about 0.9 mm of that at the towers; with the hinge end lifting in its open bearings and the paddle rolled or shifted, the plate reaches them.

retention.right_rail_limit: The right rail cannot run further back: past board station 9.8 its outer wall would stand in the upper-right keycap travel.
retention.latch: R53 spring latch on the left tine, unchanged
